description: This file contains the implementation of the ActivatorGenerator class, responsible for generating C# source code for activator classes in the Orleans distributed application framework. It defines methods to generate classes, constructors, and create methods tailored to specific serialization types, utilizing syntax generation from the Roslyn API.

classes.name: ActivatorGenerator
classes.description: A class that generates C# source code for activator implementations, enabling dynamic creation of instances of serializable types within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: ConstructorArgument
classes.description: A struct representing a constructor argument with its type, field name, and parameter name.

methods.name: GenerateActivator
methods.description: Generates a class declaration syntax representing an activator for a given serializable type, including fields, constructor, and create method.

methods.name: GetSimpleClassName
methods.description: Returns a simple name for the activator class based on the serializable type's name.

methods.name: GenerateConstructor
methods.description: Creates a constructor declaration syntax for the activator class, initializing fields with constructor parameters.

methods.name: GenerateCreateMethod
methods.description: Creates a method syntax that returns a new instance of the serializable type, using either constructor parameters or a default object creation expression.
